View in list or map views, get driving directions, phone numbers, and all the information you need to decide where and when to play.  PokerAtlas is free, fun and easy to use.

• Use GPS to find every live and online poker room in your area
• 50,000+ poker tournament and game listings
• Every major poker tournament series
• Live Wait Lists (for properties using PokerAtlas TableCaptain software)
• Live Tournament Clocks (for properties using PokerAtlas TableCaptain software)
• Online Wait List Registration (for certain properties using PokerAtlas TableCaptain software)
• Read and write Poker Room Reviews
• Read and post questions, feedback, etc., in TableTalk
• Social features such as check-Ins and sharing
• Set poker tournament schedules and notifications
• Ability to Favorite rooms, games, tournaments and events
• Online poker room listings (in legal states)
• See Announcements published directly from poker rooms

The app uses your location to show you the best poker and card room information specific to your area, as well as notifications based on your preferences. Locations are collected even if the app is in the background, in order to improve your experience on the PokerAtlas app.
